ticket.title: Extend ModelCatalog with cost and context fields; add ranked_for to selection; mandatory task_class
tasks: Extend the existing model catalog (crates/cascade-core/src/model_catalog.rs ::CatalogModel and YamlModel) with two new numeric fields: cost_usd_per_1k: f64 and context_capacity_k: u32.

These fields are added to the canonical models/models.yaml (already embedded at compile time via include_str! in model_catalog.rs at line 45) alongside the existing quota_cost_weight (prose cost, parsed into CatalogModel.cost) and context_tokens fields.
No second capability store, no CapabilityEntry struct, and no CapabilityMap struct — cost and context data live solely in CatalogModel, which is the single source of truth for model reference data.
